input.prompt: Use the supplied approved S01 PNG as the sole geometry, cargo, color and material identity authority. Render this exact same Pegasoft container freight ship in one strict orthographic full port-side profile, bow facing image right and stern/bridge to image left. Change only the camera viewpoint: no yaw, camera roll, oblique angle or perspective shortening. Preserve the complete hull length, beam, depth/freeboard, bow and stern shape, bridge footprint/height/glazing, six fore-to-aft cargo groups, four-across main bays, per-bay stack heights, forward narrowed cargo group, color order, rails, lashing bridges, ladders, anchors, winches, lifeboat, antennas and funnel hardware from S01. Do not rebuild the vessel, shorten/widen the hull, add/remove bays, change the accepted four-across cargo arrangement to five, add containers or swap their colors. Keep the same carbon hull, thin blue waterline band and original blue accent placements, cool porcelain bridge housing, actual clear lightly cool-tinted glazing, neutral brushed silver/titanium metal and silver/navy/blue cargo. Retain realistic marine metal seams, fine surface grain, corrugation, fittings and natural reflections at the same detail level as the approved master; no plastic toy appearance, inflated bevels, melted railings or simplified bridge. Keep the entire ship and tallest antennas visible with comfortable clearance on all four canvas sides. Use consistent controlled cool studio lighting; do not introduce dramatic new highlights, colors or decorative effects. Isolate one ship on transparency: no ocean, wake, clouds, ground plane, people, generated lettering/logos or multi-view sheet. Do not correct or redesign the accepted identity. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

recipe.note: These are the submitted inputs, not resolved server defaults. For a variation, copy them and change only requested fields; reuse returned_seed when supported by the schema. Source URLs may expire.

display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
